commands.desc: Disable all Claude/DC/Relay/Watchdog/Poller scheduled tasks for clean normal boot
commands.script: Get-ScheduledTask | Where-Object { $_.TaskName -match 'Claude|claude|DC|Watchdog|Poller|Relay|RelayAutoSync|DcClone|LocalThug|CloudCmd|SignalBoard|ClaudePWA' } | ForEach-Object { Disable-ScheduledTask -TaskName $_.TaskName -TaskPath $_.TaskPath -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host ('Disabled: ' + $_.TaskName) }; Write-Host 'ALL DONE'

commands.desc: Kill node, 7z, stellaris if still running
commands.script: 'node','7z','stellaris','stellaris_launcher','EasyAntiCheat','steamwebhelper' | ForEach-Object { Get-Process $_ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force }; Write-Host 'heavy procs killed'

note: Safe mode admin CMD active. Disable all Claude/DC scheduled tasks so normal boot is clean.
